extension.news:
Version 0.2.5 (October 5th, 2026) - Improve youtube stream resolution
Version 0.2.4 (October 5th, 2026) - Add YouTube video codecs multi-selection setting (defaulting to H.264 / avc1) - Support video codec filtering and prioritization in DASH MPD manifests via StandaloneContext
Version 0.2.3 (October 5th, 2026) - Fix playlistgr plugin regex unpacking error - MoQ proxy: memoize dead GoogleVideo host failures and fast failover upstream for YouTube stream relay
Version 0.2.2 (October 5th, 2026) - New playlistgr plugin - Youtube plugin now allows audio only option - MOQ proxy fixes
Version 0.2.1 (October 5th, 2026) - New greek-movies plugin
Version 0.2.0 (October 4th, 2026) - Move localhost MoQ/WebSocket to FLV + m3u8 proxy from AliveGR service into resources/lib/moq_proxy.py - Mega and Vindral resolvers now start and use the local proxy without requiring AliveGR - Add xbmc.service entry (resources/service.py) owning the proxy for the session so no proxy thread outlives the resolving invoker and Kodi exits cleanly - Dailymotion: resolve via the ungated geo.dailymotion.com/videos endpoint with player/metadata fallback; master manifest relays through the localhost proxy (fresh fetch per request, full headers) so VOD and live play globally - YouTube: native resolver on the vendored ytresolver engine (net.py transport only) serving the generated DASH manifest through the localhost proxy for inputstream.adaptive, replacing the plugin.video.youtube pass-through - Add proxy_port setting and script.module.websocket dependency - Add eltube
Version 0.1.18 (September 27th, 2026) - Remove greekfun - Remove artlive - Add anacon - Add kick - Add vindral
